args.subject: Re: CarePortal Handoff & November Invoice
args.body:
Hi Sarah,

Thank you for your message regarding the November invoice for the CarePortal UX Redesign project.

Please find attached your invoice INV-2026-118. The total amount due is $800.00, covering 35.5 billed hours across various design tasks (Telehealth Appointment Booking, Patient EHR Records Flow, Mobile Responsive Breakpoints, Design System Token Documentation, and Figma Component Library Maintenance).

Our payment terms for this invoice are Net 15, with the due date of November 15, 2026. Please let me know if you need any further details or clarification on the line items.

Best regards,
Elena Gomez
Studio Gomez Design LLC
